root_cause.note: Debug server unpickles client-supplied cloudpickle payloads.

evidence.analysis: ucx-py debug-tests server deserialises a client-supplied cloudpickle payload (cloudpickle.loads(func)) with no authentication: any peer reaching the debug endpoint gets arbitrary code execution by design of the debug tool. Debug tooling is not the production wheel path, and the server needs CUDA/UCX/distributed stacks that this Windows host cannot run, so the case is static-only with the trust boundary recorded.
